$comment: External dependency registry (DEPS-GOV, owner 2026-09-29). Single source of truth for which arch unit (src/<pkg>/<tier>/<unit>) or package (src/<pkg>) may import each npm package; lint-arch enforces owners, package.json parity, embedded components and review intervals offline and warns when nextReview has passed; scripts/deps-watch.mjs refreshes versions, OSV, provenance and licenses over the network. Seeded from proof/DEPENDENCY-AUDIT-2026-09-29 (A/B/C) with npm registry data read 2026-09-29.

@modelcontextprotocol/client.purpose: MCP client for the runtime service's external MCP tool servers (stdio launch, list/pin, call).
features: Client (connect, listTools cacheMode bypass + timeout + signal, callTool, getProtocolEra, getNegotiatedProtocolVersion, getServerVersion, close)
ClientOptions.jsonSchemaValidator (the jsonSchemaValidator provider interface) given Deckent's own validator, #platform/core/validate (MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR)
lazy import() so CLI start does not load the SDK

alternatives.name: fastmcp
alternatives.note: Server framework layered on the official SDK; not an independent client implementation.

@modelcontextprotocol/client.ownSolution: Own stdio JSON-RPC client behind the mcp-client port is feasible (one unit) but would move spec tracking (2026-07-28 stateless era, OAuth, MRTR) to us; audit A judged it a bad trade today. Own JSON Schema validator: built (MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR, owner 2026-09-29) behind the SDK's jsonSchemaValidator interface — 2020-12 + draft-07 subset, linear-time pattern engine, bounded compile/validation, unsupported features refused; replaces @cfworker/json-schema (proof/MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR-2026-09-29).
watch: FASTURI-OUT (owner 2026-09-29): the published package does not contain the embedded ajv/ajv-formats/fast-uri/json-schema-traverse; scripts/build-dist.mjs loads _shims and validators/ajv with their ajvProvider import replaced by a stub that throws DeckentRemovedValidatorError (MCP_DEFAULT_VALIDATOR_REMOVED), and fails the build if the metafile, shipped packages or sourcemap-embedded components name them. They remain in the installed dev/test tree (embedded[] below mirrors the installed sourcemaps).

Embedded fast-uri@3.1.0 carries 8 HIGH OSV advisories (fixed 3.1.7/4.1.4); a remote outputSchema is compiled only by Deckent's own validator (MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR); upstream rebuild tracked in typescript-sdk#2042/#2036.

MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR (owner 2026-09-29): the SDK's embedded @cfworker/json-schema@4.1.1 (last release 2025-01-31; cfworker#335/#337 fail-closed, #150 $dynamicRef fail-open; ReDoS through pattern) is no longer used or shipped; build-dist refuses cfWorkerProvider/@cfworker/json-schema like ajv. It remains in the installed dev/test tree (embedded[] mirrors the installed sourcemaps).
MCP-PIN-DEF: pass the pinned toolDefinition to callTool; -32020 resend is a checkpoint.

@modelcontextprotocol/server.purpose: deckent-mcp server: the protocol surface external agents use to drive Deckent over stdio.
features: low-level Server with setRequestHandler tools/list + tools/call, capabilities.tools and jsonSchemaValidator
ServerOptions.jsonSchemaValidator given Deckent's own validator, #platform/core/validate (MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR; FASTURI-OUT: the SDK default is stubbed in the published package)
Transport, TransportSendOptions, JSONRPCMessage, MessageExtraInfo, RequestId, Tool, CallToolResult types (bounded own transport in mcp-transport)

alternatives.name: fastmcp
alternatives.note: Higher-level server framework on top of the official SDK; would not remove the SDK or its embedded ajv.

@modelcontextprotocol/server.ownSolution: We parse tool input with our own zod schemas and use only the low-level Server; an own stdio JSON-RPC server would drop ajv/zod4/eventsource/jose from the tree but take on spec tracking. The ajv default validator is out of the published package (build-dist stub, FASTURI-OUT) and the Server gets Deckent's own validator through the SDK's jsonSchemaValidator interface (MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR).
watch: Server dist loads the embedded ajvProvider unconditionally (shimsNode) in the installed dev/test tree; the published package loads a stub instead (FASTURI-OUT) and the Server gets Deckent's own validator explicitly (MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR; the SDK's cf-worker provider is neither used nor shipped).
Three nested zod@4.6.5 copies under the SDK packages until our zod 4 migration dedupes them.

watch: No npm provenance on ink or most of its subtree.
ink 7.1 suspendTerminal() for editor/shell hand-off is unused.
Unpin react when an ink release moves to react-reconciler 0.34.

DEPS-P0 (owner 2026-09-29) pins react to 19.2.8 instead; verified via `npm ls react react-reconciler` (deduped, no mismatch). Revisit when ink moves to react-reconciler 0.34 (peers ^19.3.0).

Owners are package-wide for the contract layers; narrow after the zod 4 migration.

esbuild.purpose: Bundles the runtime dependencies into the published package (DEPS-DIST, owner 2026-09-29): zero install-time dependencies, one tarball for air-gapped installs; its metafile is the SBOM source.

metafile inputs/outputs with bytesInOutput (SBOM shipped vs tree-shaken)

esbuild.ownSolution: None: a bundler is not a Deckent capability; esbuild is a single native binary with no dependencies of its own besides its platform package.

acceptedRisks.mitigation: Not shipped (FASTURI-OUT, owner 2026-09-29): the published package's build replaces the SDK's ajvProvider with a throwing stub and fails if ajv/fast-uri reach the bundle; its SBOM names neither, and deps-watch --sbom stops accepting this entry if it ever does (shipped: false). Accepted only for the installed dev/test tree, where the SDK still carries the code: Deckent passes its own validator to every SDK Client and Server (static + runtime contract test; MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR), the client compiles a server's outputSchema only on it (MCP-VALIDATOR) and every tools/call carries the pinned tool definition (MCP-PIN-DEF). Remove when the SDK ships a rebuilt bundle (typescript-sdk#2042/#2036).
evidence: proof/FASTURI-OUT-2026-09-29/review.md (tarball grep, SBOM, pack-smoke Node 24.21/26.10, guard mutation)
proof/MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR-2026-09-29/astra-2180-adaptation.md (Astra 2180 R2: $dynamicRef refused before send; red on 0a69a70, green on the merge)
acceptedRisks.decidedBy: lead (re-signed after MCP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR, eleventh batch integration, 2026-09-29)
